units.source_text: 他還告訴我，攤販賣的牛肉蓋飯和雞肉烤串既便宜又營養；

en.t: He also told me that the beef bowls and grilled chicken skewers sold at street stalls were both cheap and nourishing;

units.source_text: 還向我保證說，「電氣白蘭地」這個牌子的酒是上頭最快的。

en.t: and he assured me that the liquor called "Denki Bran" was the quickest to make you drunk.

units.source_text: 總之，跟他一起結賬付款，再也感覺不到任何的恐懼與不安。

en.t: In any case, when it came to settling the bill with him, I no longer felt any fear or uneasiness at all.

units.source_text: 與堀木交往的另一個好處，則是他完全無視對方的想法，

en.t: Another advantage of associating with Horiki was that he completely ignored what the other person was thinking,

units.source_text: 只是一味地釋放自己的激情（或許他所謂的激情就是無視對方的立場），

en.t: and simply poured out his own passion (perhaps what he called passion was just ignoring the other person's position),

units.source_text: 一天到晚沒完沒了嘮叨著無聊的話題，

en.t: chattering on endlessly all day long about trivial subjects,

units.source_text: 完全不用擔心兩個人走累了會陷入尷尬的沉默。

en.t: so there was absolutely no need to worry that, after the two of us grew tired from walking, we would fall into an awkward silence.
